properties.name: The Trinity cloud
properties.stands_for: The false dawn, read as the Trinity test of 16 July 1945 (J7)
properties.note_safe: Before daybreak Billy is woken by a great white light that floods the country and then dies away, long before the real dawn. Readers take it for the first atomic bomb, tested at the Trinity Site on 16 July 1945.
properties.reasoning: The book names no place or event for the light. The drawing stands on the Trinity Site itself (Wikidata Q19842077), in the empty Jornada del Muerto, at the far end of the direction the dotted false-dawn line points from the waystation. The drawing is set on the north side of its own place, beside the pin rather than on it; it is not to scale, and it shows roughly where the scene happens, not exactly.
properties.label: Trinity test, 16 July 1945
properties.credit: Cap traced from the Trinity test photograph, US government, 1945 (public domain)
